rules.quote:
(a) It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an
algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.requirement: No person may sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord.
rules.title: Sale of algorithmic rent-setting devices prohibited

rules.anchor_quote:
This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from
and after its final passage.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to all landlords of residential rental property in San Diego.
rules.effective_expression: thirtieth day from and after its final passage

exemptions.description: Software used to set rents or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines

key_values.name: max_civil_penalty
key_values.text:
civil penalties of up to
$1,000 per violation

rules.penalty: Tenant civil action: injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation; attorney's fees
rules.quote:
(b) It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates
or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.requirement: A landlord may not use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels. Each month and each property of use is a separate violation.
rules.title: Landlord use of algorithmic devices prohibited
